ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 3:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels on lateral lobes to low-intensity black pixels in the central and marginal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white pigmentation on the primary surface area of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a central wedge-like region with irregular, feathered borders extending from the peduncle attachment toward the trailing edge. Narrow black banding is localized along the entire trailing edge perimeter.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; approximately 65-degree interior angle with a deep vertical depression relative to the horizontal axis of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration map; numerous irregular peaks and valleys (ranging 5-15 pixels in depth) distributed continuously along the trailing edge from the notch to the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edges; trailing edge trajectory is primarily horizontal with a distinctive upward distal sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse, roughly circular yellowish-brown pixel clusters on the central-left lobe; dense high-contrast dark pixel clusters (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruption on the right lobe, extending diagonally from the central black pigmentation into the white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustations on the distal tips of both fluke lobes; minor yellowish surface staining on the interior white regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant protrusion of barnacle clusters on the right fluke tip, altering the expected geometric profile of the lobe apex.
